route_title: Locked cavity with full Bragg mirror optimization (25-layer SiO2/Al2O3)
compilation_rationale: Replaced null targets in tmm_task.targets with valid float thresholds (0.99 for maximization, 0.01 for minimization) to resolve the float conversion error. Enabled optimization with correct ±20% quarter-wave bounds for layers 18-24 as specified.
